name: uk_companies_house-mcp
description: Companies House (sales): me, search, get_company. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_uk_companies_house_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_UK_COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY
platform_mcp_uk_companies_house_api_key.description: Companies House Public Data API key (free, from https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk/). Sent as the HTTP Basic user name with an empty password: 'the Companies House API takes the username as the API key and ignores the password' (https://developer-specs.company-information.service.gov.uk/guides/authorisation).

tools.name: me
tools.description: Verified with a one-item company search (Companies House has no account endpoint).

tools.name: search
tools.description: UK register only: the `country` and `industry` arguments are not search parameters here and are ignored. Search items carry no SIC codes or website; `links.self` is a relative API path, so `url` is left unset (see raw.links.self). `restrictions=active-companies` is a documented option not applied by default.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: `id` is the company number from search. `address` is the first line only; the full registered_office_address object and every SIC code are under raw. No website field is documented.
